entry.title: 🇮🇳 SAP Build: Advanced Event Mesh - Event based SAP Build Process Automation (Bengaluru, India)
entry.content:
REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED FOR THIS EVENT - We will send confirmation emails to FIRST 30 registered participants one week before the event. 

This is the all-new SAP CodeJam for SAP Build low-code/no-code tooling that focuses on giving you hands-on experience for building event-triggered processes with SAP Build Process Automation.

You will build an event-based scenario that lets users create S/4HANA business partners, setting off a process where:
  1. An employee approves the creation of a site access badge.
  2. A second employee, determined based on the details of the business partner, may also need to approve the badge.
  3. The process calls an external, 3rd-party badge system and waits to be called back.
  4. A user creates the badge and the badge system calls back the process instance.
  5. A notification with the badge ID is sent.

 

The scenario is built in 2 halves:
 
SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh: You will learn about events, CloudEvents, events in the SAP landscape, the process for publishing and subscribing to events, and your way around SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh. Then, you will create a REST Delivery Point in advanced event mesh to forward events to your SAP Build on your SAP BTP trial account.
 
SAP Build Process Automation: You will create a process from scratch to handle the issuance of site access badges. You will learn the basics of SAP Build Process Automation (projects, triggers, conditions, creating instances, monitoring, and the Inbox), and also use some of the more recent or advanced features (event triggers, form events, waiting for a API callback).
 
Prerequisites
  • Bring your own laptop with power adapter and have a supported Web browser such as Google Chrome or Firefox installed on your laptop.
  • It can be helpful to bring a tablet or second laptop, if you have.
  • Complete these prerequisites and the required reading BEFORE you come: 
    • Introduction to the CodeJam
    • Prerequisites
    • Required reading:
      • 1 - Exploring Events and More in the SAP Business Accelerator Hub
      • 2 - Why Event-Driven Architectures?

Location and Date

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Thursday, January 29th, 2026 from 9:30 - 16:00 local time in Bengaluru, India. The language of the event and the content will be English. 

Event Address:  Ericsson Global, AQUAMARINE WTC 03 and CITRINE WTC 04, Bagmane World Technology Centre, SEZ, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka, 560048

Google maps location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/xJHoXAdLbEHKR9CHA 

  • The instructors are SAP Developer Advocates  @ajay_soreng  and @Rekha_DR 
  • Thank you Ericsson Global for hosting this event.

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 30 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. About two weeks before the event, you will be asked to confirm your attendance via email.

entry.title: 🇦🇺 Gen AI Hub & Joule Studio : Create Skills and AI Agents to Extend Joule (Brisbane, Australia)
entry.content:
Registration for this event is now closed as we’ve reached full capacity. All confirmed participants will receive an email two weeks prior to the event date. 

This SAP CodeJam event comprised of 2 parts.

1. Getting Started with Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core with Python. You do not need any background in the topic, but you should have a lot of curiosity! Here you will learn how to use the Generative AI Hub on SAP AI Core to implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This approach improves the responses of large language models (LLMs) and reduces hallucinations. You will learn how to deploy an LLM and the orchestration service on SAP AI Core, and how to query it via SAP AI Launchpad and the Python SDK. Additionally, you will gain insights into key generative AI concepts and learn how to enhance RAG responses.

2. Introduce you to the Joule Studio tool, so you can create your own:

  • Skills, which let you create predefined execution flows, triggered by a user's prompt inside the Joule chatbot
  • Agents, which lets you define complex scenarios that the agent can execute by iteratively reasoning and interacting with their environment to achieve a goal, using a selected LLM, and triggered by a user's prompt inside the Joule chatbot

Prerequisites

  • Bring your own laptop with power adapter and have a supported Web browser such as Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge installed on your laptop. Joule Studio is only supported on Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Other browsers are not supported.
  • It can be helpful to bring a tablet or second laptop, if you have, to have the instructions on a separate screen.

Location and Date 

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Friday, February 13, 2026 from 09:00 - 15:30 local time in Brisbane, Australia AEST (Australian Eastern Standard Time). The language of the event and the content will be English.

Event Address: Gold Tower, Level 27/10 Eagle St, Brisbane City QLD 4000, Australia

  • The event is kindly being hosted by UpperGround by Hudson
  • The instructors are SAP Developer Advocates @Shilpa_Shankar and @Rekha_DR 

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 35 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. About 2 weeks before the event, you will be asked to confirm your attendance and will receive further instructions.

entry.title: 🇦🇺 Joule Studio: Create Skills and Agents to Extend Joule (Sydney, Australia)
entry.content:
This is the all-new SAP CodeJam for Joule Studio, the new tool in SAP Build that lets you create extensions to Joule so users can use SAP's digital assistant in their custom workflows.

 

 

The CodeJam is intended to introduce you to the Joule Studio tool, so you can create your own:

  • Skills, which let you create predefined execution flows, triggered by a user's prompt inside the Joule chatbot
  • Agents, which lets you define complex scenarios that the agent can execute by iteratively reasoning and interacting with their environment to achieve a goal, using a selected LLM, and triggered by a user's prompt inside the Joule chatbot

The session will include a short, simple introduction to the SAP AI tools and some basic concepts needed for working with Joule Studio – such as AI Core, document grounding, embeddings, and what after all is an LLM.

Prerequisites

  • Bring your own laptop with power adapter and have a Browser installed. Joule Studio is only supported on Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Other browsers are not supported.
  • It can be helpful to bring a tablet or second laptop, if you have, to have the instructions on a separate screen.

Location and Date 

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Tuesday, February 10, 2026 from 012:30 - 16:00 local time in Sydney, Australia(AEDT). The language of the event and the content will be English.

Event Address: SAP Sydney Office - Level 13/1 Denison Street, North Sydney

  • The event is part of an “SAP Exploration Workshop” and is hosted by SAP Australia
  • The instructors are SAP Developer Advocates @Shilpa_Shankar  & @Rekha_DR 

Please note that spaces are limited! We can only accommodate 35 attendees. If you want to attend, register by clicking on this link  https://events.sap.com/au-agentic-ai-exploration-workshop/en_us/home.html 

About 2 weeks before the event, you will be asked to confirm your attendance and will receive further instructions.

entry.title: 🇳🇿 SAP CodeJam ABAP : SAP BTP, ABAP Environment & RAP (Auckland, New Zealand)
entry.content:
This SAP CodeJam event is on the topic of the ABAP Cloud, and specifically introduces attendees to ABAP Cloud and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model. ABAP Cloud is the ABAP-based development model for S/4HANA Cloud, S/4HANA on-premise, and SAP BTP, ABAP environment.

Learn how to use proven and new technologies, such as Core Data Services (CDS) and behavior definition and implementation languages, to build SAP Fiori apps and OData services on any of the ABAP Cloud options. In this hands-on experience, developers will create their first ABAP applications using ABAP Cloud, expose and consume services via HTTP, and explore the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model.

This is an in-person event only (not virtual) and is planned for Wednesday, 18th February 2026 in Auckland, New Zealand from 09:00 - 15:30 (NZDT). The language and content of the event will be in English.

Location: SAP New Zealand Limited - Auckland - Level 15/151 Queen Street, Auckland Central, Auckland 1010, New Zealand

The event is  hosted by SAP New Zealand Limited - Auckland. Please note that spaces are limited - we can only accommodate 30 attendees. If you wish to attend, register by clicking the Yes button in the Will you be attending? section above to the right. A few weeks before the event, we will ask you to confirm your attendance.

The instructors are Developer Advocates @Shilpa_Shankar and @Rekha_DR 

There are essential prerequisites that must be completed by every attendee, before arriving at the event location. They are documented here: abap-exercises-codejam/prerequisites.md at main · SAP-samples/abap-exercises-codejam (github.com).

For more information on SAP CodeJam events, to ask questions, and to chat with your fellow attendees, head over to the SAP CodeJam group.

entry.title: 🇮🇳 Build Code-based AI Agents on SAP Business AI Platform (Bengaluru, India)
entry.content:
REGISTRATION IS NOW CLOSED FOR THIS EVENT - We will send confirmation emails to first 35 attendees a couple of weeks before the event and we will manage a waitlist, in case some of the RSVPs are unable to make it to the event.

entry.title: August Developer Challenge Week 1 – Joule
entry.content:
The challenge is now closed. You can still perform the challenge, but no additional badges will be awarded. A summary of how we awarded badges and who completed ALL the tasks are shown in our blog post August Developer Challenge - NOW CLOSED.

This is part of the August Developer Challenge on Joule Studio.

Dear SAP Community,

We SAP Developer Advocates are very much excited to welcome you all to the Week 1 of New Joule Studio Developer Challenge. You could complete this Week's challenge during your coffee-break, that's all it takes and stay on Top of what matters.

AI is fundamentally changing enterprise software and business processes.

SAP’s direction is clear – It is an Autonomous Enterprise that runs specialised AI assistants and AI agents that execute and manage end-to-end business processes and tasks. This challenge helps you align in this direction.  

First and foremost, we need to understand SAP’s Enterprise AI Solution “Joule”. 

This week you will explore the SAP Learning Course “Introducing Joule” .

Your Task 

Step 1: Click on the link Introducing Joule 

On the top right corner, click on the User Icon to logon to SAP Learning with your SAP Universal ID and password. If you do not have one, then refer to Creating SAP Universal ID 

 

Click “Start Learning”.

 

 

 

Go through Unit 1 ONLY to take lessons within this unit. Then complete the quiz.  

The other 3 units are purely OPTIONAL. If you have EXTRA time/ interested to go deep, complete the entire course, you will be awarded a Course Completion Badge. 

Step 2: 

Your Week 1 Challenge Question: For which 2 products, SAP Joule was first made available?  

You need to Submit the answer via this Submit your Answer . You need your SAP community ID while submitting the answer. Easily fetch your SAP community ID by following the steps from the screenshot below which is important.

 

Step 3:  Have you have ever experienced Joule hands-on at your organisation or during Events? If yes, then in which products? Post your valuable comments in this blog post. 

Hope you have enjoyed this challenge and learned valuable concepts around Joule Product. Will see you again next week with Week 2 challenge. Stay tuned!

entry.title: August Developer Challenge Week 2 – New Joule Studio
entry.content:
The challenge is now closed. You can still perform the challenge, but no additional badges will be awarded. A summary of how we awarded badges and who completed ALL the tasks are shown in our blog post August Developer Challenge - NOW CLOSED.

                               

 

This is part of the August Developer Challenge on Joule Studio.

Now that you have a background in SAP Joule, we come to the part everyone is waiting for:  New Joule Studio. SAP Joule Studio is SAP’s AI-first development environment for building custom AI agents, apps, and workflows. Powered by the SAP Business AI Platform.

During this challenge, you will be taking up a course to build your foundational knowledge about the New Joule Studio, which was announced during Sapphire 2026 in May. 

Your Task 

Step 1:  Click on this link: Introducing Joule Studio.   

Step 2: On the top right corner, click on the User Icon to log on to SAP Learning with your SAP Universal ID and password. 

Click on “Start Learning” to begin the course. 

You will be offered 3 units to complete.  

Unit 1: Big-Picture SAP Business AI Platform – Pillars of SAP Business AI Platform.  

Unit 2: Joule Studio – Intent-Based development, Demo, Creating AI Agent 

Unit 3: n8n Workflows in Joule Studio – creating n8n workflows in Joule Studio.

You Nailed it! We are happy that you have earned yourself an Achievement Badge. Click on this badge.  

You will be navigated to the “Completed” activity page. Find the record with the course “Introducing Joule Studio” and click on View Badge. 

You will be offered a pop-up. Click on “Make badge public”. 

 

Make a screenshot of this pop-up and post it in the comments of this blog post along with your answer for the question below:

Question for this Week's Challenge: Comment for this blog post at least ONE key difference between the Classic Joule Studio and the New Joule Studio.  

Here we see who has earned the Badge and when. You can see the options to publicly share your Badge on LinkedIn, save as PDF etc. Do not forget to share this badge on LinkedIn if you like!  

Well done! We believe you are having in this learning process so far. From next week, you will get hands-on. We look forward to seeing you there. Stay connected and stay happy!

entry.title: Joule Work: The New Way of Working
entry.content:
Joule Work serves as an intelligent, unified, user-aware, experience framework, connecting users to capabilities across SAP and beyond through intent, context, and conversational AI. Learn how it transforms how work happens, unifying tasks, insights, and content within a dynamic information architecture using interaction models where users act through intent, receive proactive support, and interact with task-oriented agents that execute across the users suite of applications.

Christian Hoffman

entry.title: Meet Joule Studio and Build Your First Agent
entry.content:
Meet Joule Studio — SAP's answer to custom AI development. Joule Studio is a platform where anyone from business users to pro-code developers can go from a plain-language prompt to a fully deployed agent or workflow.

Join this session to get familiar with Joule Studio, intent-based development, and how it turns a simple business problem statement into a fully deployed agent.

Jennifer Niederlaender — Jennifer Niederländer serves as a Product Manager for Joule Studio, supporting customer engagements and enablement initiatives. She is passionate about helping customers realize value through innovation and collaboration. Outside of work, Jennifer enjoys traveling, staying active at the gym, and spending time reading.
